town.label: Town
town.hint: Rest here: HP and mana back to full. A shop inside.

shop.label: Shop
shop.hint: Plain gear of this area's rank, potions and dice cards; it buys what you carry too.

normal.label: Wilds
normal.hint: This area's creatures roam here, and now and then something else turns up.

chest.label: Chest
chest.hint: Gold, and maybe something to wear. Fills again after a while.

potion.label: Spring
potion.hint: Fill a flask: one potion. Flows again after a while.

spell.label: Shrine
spell.hint: Learn an ability of your class, or improve one you know. Once in a while.

boss.label: Boss
boss.hint: Land exactly here to fight it. Beat it and the way beyond opens. It is back five minutes later.

church.label: Church
church.hint: Heals you fully and takes off poison and weakness. Always open, and free.
